title: Ratchet strap anchor (close-up)
blurb: One anchor, filling the frame. This is the photo shape tie-down counting is built on: SAM reads a strap at 0.79+ confidence here, versus invisible at full-frame distance.
photo_credit: Development photo, public domain (U.S. Army). Inputs: load 8 ft.

verdicts.finding: Forward blocking cannot be judged: there is no calibrated measurement of the load against the bed (no measurement run was supplied). Run the measurement stage with the trailer bed length to enable this check.
verdicts.confidence_basis: no calibration: no measurement run was supplied

verdicts.finding: Only 1 tie-down(s) counted; 393.110 requires 2 for a 8 ft load. Short by 1.
verdicts.minimum_fix: Add at least 1 more tie-down(s), spaced along the load, before rolling.
verdicts.confidence_basis: 1 counted from close-up detections and user marks (0 user-added); full-frame bonus-only strap signals are never counted
verdicts.fix: Add at least 1 more tie-down(s), spaced along the load, before rolling.

verdicts.cfr_citation: 49 CFR Part 393, Subpart I (overhang; lights and plate visibility)
verdicts.finding: Overhang: not measured (no measurement run supplied). Lights and plate: not checked (needs the rear photo read by the cross-check; segmentation cannot judge whether lights or the plate are obscured).
verdicts.confidence_basis: no measurement and no rear cross-check supplied
verdicts.citation: 49 CFR Part 393, Subpart I (overhang; lights and plate visibility)

verdicts.cfr_citation: 49 CFR 393.100 (load placement; visual estimate only here)
verdicts.finding: Weight placement cannot be called: no centroid measurement was supplied. Placement is a visual estimate only in any case - a photo shows where the bulk sits, never how heavy it is.
verdicts.confidence_basis: visual estimate only; no usable centroid measurement
verdicts.citation: 49 CFR 393.100 (load placement; visual estimate only here)

verdicts.finding: Edge protection cannot be judged from the evidence supplied: it needs a close-up of each strap where it crosses an edge, read for protectors. Take an anchor close-up per tie-down and run the cross-check.
verdicts.confidence_basis: no close-up cross-check evidence about straps over edges

verdicts.finding: Tie-down strength cannot be checked from the photo: a photo cannot verify working load limit ratings or load weight, and this check needs both numbers. Missing: no tie-down working load limit ratings were supplied; no load weight was supplied. Supply the load weight and each tie-down's rating and this check runs on those numbers.
verdicts.confidence_basis: not computable: no tie-down working load limit ratings were supplied; no load weight was supplied

report.headline: Steel load short one tie-down needs fix before rolling
report.body: This is an 8.0 ft steel load on a utility trailer. Tie-down count fails. Only 1 tie-down was counted but 2 are required. You are short by 1. Add at least 1 more tie-down spaced along the load before rolling. Forward blocking could not be told. It needs a measurement run with the trailer bed length to judge it. Overhang and lights and plate could not be told. Overhang needs a measurement run. Lights and plate need the rear photo read by the cross-check. Weight placement could not be told. It needs a centroid measurement, and placement from a photo is a visual estimate only. Edge protection could not be told. It needs a close-up of each strap where it crosses an edge. Take an anchor close-up per tie-down and run the cross-check. Tie-down strength could not be told. It needs tie-down ratings and load weight. A photo cannot verify strap tension, tie-down ratings, or load weight.
